name: Kiki
waitingLines: GUESS WHAT!! I’m not leaving till I see {partner}!! I have SO much to tell them!!
Where’s {partner}?? I’ve been here two minutes and I already miss them!!

questions.scene: Kiki bursts through your door, stands up tall on his hind legs, and scans the room like a security camera.
lines: GUESS WHAT!! I'm on lookout duty! Also quiz duty! Multitasking!!
questions.question: What job do meerkats take turns doing while the others eat?

choices.label: Cooking dinner
reply: Ha!! I wish! Moss would love a chef!
Nope, it's sentry duty: one stands watch while the others forage.
They even call out 'all clear' with little peeps. Tiny security guards!!

choices.label: DJ-ing the party
reply: Okay, that would slap. But no!!
The real job is sentry duty. One meerkat keeps watch for danger.
They peep softly to say 'all good.' Best coworkers ever.

choices.label: Standing guard as a sentry
reply: YES!! Sentry duty! My favorite job!
One meerkat climbs up high and watches for danger while the group eats.
They make little 'all clear' peeps. I do that at parties too.

questions.factBasis: Meerkats take turns as sentinels while others forage.

questions.scene: Kiki bleats like a goat, then giggles at himself.
lines: GUESS WHAT!! Goats have accents! I'm not joking!
questions.question: What did scientists find about young goats' calls?

choices.label: They can sing in harmony
reply: That would be iconic!! But no!
Their calls shift to sound like their social group's.
Goat accents. Real science. Best fact ever.

choices.label: Their calls change to sound like their friends'
reply: YES!! Goat accents!!
Young goats in the same group start to sound more alike.
Peer pressure but make it adorable. I'd have the loudest accent.

choices.label: They only bleat at night
reply: Nope! They bleat all day!
Kid goats' calls become more similar to their group mates'.
Friends influence how they sound. Like me and my vocabulary.

questions.factBasis: Briefer & McElligott (2012): pygmy goat kids' calls converge within social groups.

questions.scene: Kiki tiptoes, very quietly, which for him is still kind of loud.
lines: This one's about Moss! He's a dormouse!
questions.question: How long can a hazel dormouse hibernate?

choices.label: Around six months or more
reply: YES!! Half the year!
Dormice can hibernate from autumn until spring.
I miss him SO much in winter. I text him anyway. He reads them in April.

choices.label: About one week
reply: Ha!! Moss would be OFFENDED!
Hazel dormice can hibernate for around six months, sometimes more.
Half the year asleep. Moss calls it 'peak introvert.'

choices.label: They never hibernate
reply: Oh, they absolutely do!!
Hazel dormice hibernate around six months, sometimes longer.
Their name may even come from an old word for 'sleepy.' Moss agrees.

questions.factBasis: Hazel dormice hibernate roughly Oct–Apr, around 6+ months.

questions.scene: Kiki tickles the air near your side, then laughs.
lines: Guess what!! Rats laugh!! When you tickle them!!
questions.question: What do rats do when they're tickled?

choices.label: Run away screaming
reply: Nope!! They come back for more!
They make ultrasonic laughing sounds, too high for us to hear.
They even chase the tickling hand. Adorable.

choices.label: Make high-pitched 'laughing' squeaks
reply: YES!! Rat giggles!!
They make ultrasonic chirps, and even seek more tickles.
Tickle fights are universal. I'm so happy.

choices.label: Fall asleep instantly
reply: Ha!! No!!
They make high-pitched chirps, like laughter.
Scientists found they love being tickled. Same.

questions.factBasis: Panksepp's research: rats emit 50-kHz ultrasonic chirps when tickled and seek it out.

questions.scene: Kiki whistles a little three-note tune, then points at himself.
lines: That was my name! In whistle! Moss has his own whistle too. He never uses it.
questions.question: How do bottlenose dolphins call each other by name?

choices.label: They use signature whistles
reply: YES!! Each dolphin has its own whistle name!
Others can copy a dolphin's signature whistle to call it.
Name tags but make it music. I'm OBSESSED.

choices.label: They splash in Morse code
reply: Okay, that's genius, but no!
They use signature whistles that work like names.
Dolphins can copy a friend's whistle to call them. Iconic.

choices.label: They don't have names
reply: They totally do!!
Each dolphin develops a signature whistle, basically its name.
Others whistle it back to get their attention. Group chat goals.

questions.factBasis: Bottlenose dolphins use individual signature whistles that function like names.

questions.scene: Kiki spots a tiny bug on your wall, then crouches like he's teaching a class.
lines: Guess what!! Meerkat school is in session!
questions.question: How do adult meerkats teach pups to eat dangerous scorpions?

choices.label: They draw diagrams in the sand
reply: Ha!! Adorable! Not real!
Adults bring pups dead or de-stung scorpions to practice on.
As pups get older, the scorpions get more 'real.' Level up!

choices.label: They don't. Pups figure it out alone
reply: Nope! Meerkat parents are way more supportive!
Adults bring pups practice scorpions with the stinger removed.
Step by step. Very gentle parenting. Very Finch-approved.

choices.label: They bring practice scorpions with the stinger removed
reply: CORRECT!! Training wheels for snacks!
Adults bring dead or stingless scorpions first, then gradually harder ones.
Real teaching! Scientists actually studied this. Smart teachers!!

questions.factBasis: Meerkat helpers teach pups by providing disabled scorpions (McAuliffe & Thornton studies).

questions.scene: Kiki grins at you. Then grins wider. Then waits for you to grin back.
lines: Guess what!! You just smiled back! I KNEW it!
questions.question: Why do people often smile back when someone smiles at them?

choices.label: It's rude not to
reply: Manners help! But there's more!
We automatically mimic facial expressions, often without noticing.
Smiles are basically emotional Wi-Fi.

choices.label: We naturally mimic others' facial expressions
reply: YES!! Smiles are contagious!
People often copy expressions without thinking, helping us connect.
That's why I smile at everyone. Spreading the vibe!!

choices.label: Smiling burns calories
reply: Ha!! If only!
It's because we naturally mimic others' facial expressions.
Copying smiles helps us bond. Science of good vibes.

questions.factBasis: Facial mimicry: people spontaneously mimic observed expressions, including smiles.

questions.scene: Kiki wiggles his whole body in a figure-eight on your rug.
lines: Guess what!! This dance is a MAP!
questions.question: What does a honeybee's 'waggle dance' do?

choices.label: Celebrates a bee's birthday
reply: Adorable!! But no!
It shows other bees where to find food.
The direction and duration of the waggle point to the flowers.

choices.label: Tells other bees where to find food
reply: YES!! A dance that gives directions!
The angle and length of the waggle show direction and distance to flowers.
Imagine giving directions through choreography. I'd never stop dancing.

choices.label: Scares away wasps
reply: Brave! But not it!
It tells hive-mates the direction and distance to food.
A whole dance-based map system. Bees are geniuses.

questions.factBasis: Honeybee waggle dance communicates direction and distance to food.

questions.scene: Kiki fills your bathtub and sits in it, sighing dramatically, like a spa guest.
lines: Guess what!! Monkeys do this! In SNOW!
questions.question: What do some Japanese macaques do in winter?

choices.label: Soak in natural hot springs
reply: YES!! Monkey spa day!!
Some groups bathe in hot springs to stay warm in snowy winters.
Studies even suggest it lowers their stress. Self-care queens.

choices.label: Build snowmen
reply: That would be the cutest!! No!
They soak in hot springs to stay warm.
Steamy baths in the snow. Peak luxury.

choices.label: Migrate to the beach
reply: Ha!! Too far!
Some soak in natural hot springs in winter.
Snow monkeys with spa routines. I'm jealous.

questions.factBasis: Some Japanese macaques bathe in hot springs in winter; linked to lower stress hormones.

questions.scene: Kiki rolls a tiny ball across the floor and chases it, delighted.
lines: Guess what!! Bees PLAY! With BALLS! For FUN!
questions.question: What did a study find bumblebees do with tiny balls?

choices.label: Use them to build hives
reply: Nope!! Hives are wax!
They rolled them around with no reward, seemingly for fun.
Tiny bees, tiny balls, big joy.

choices.label: Throw them at wasps
reply: Ha!! Bee dodgeball! No!
They just rolled them, with no food reward. Possibly play!
Even busy bees take breaks. Lesson learned.

choices.label: Roll them around, apparently just for fun
reply: YES!! Bees playing!!
They rolled balls with no reward, and young bees did it most.
Play is for everyone. Even bees. I'm crying happy tears.

questions.factBasis: Dona et al. (2022): bumblebees rolled balls without reward, suggestive of play.

questions.scene: Kiki bounces on your couch holding two invitations: one glittery, one plain.
lines: GUESS WHAT!! It's Friday! Moss already said no.
questions.question: Friday night: a big party, or a cozy night in?

choices.label: A big party
reply: A big party!! YES!! My people!
Music! Snacks! Forty new best friends!

choices.label: A cozy night in
reply: A cozy night in. Moss would adore you.
Blankets, a movie, and zero small talk. Honestly? Fair.

A:A: Big party for both of you!! Unstoppable!
So you and {partner} probably leave the party with three new group chats.
Bring me next time. I'll bring confetti.
A:B: Cozy night for you. {partner} wants the party.
Let them go for an hour. You keep the couch warm.
They'll come home with stories. You'll have the snacks ready. Team.
B:A: Party for you!! {partner} wants a cozy night in.
Moss and I have this exact fight every week.
Our fix: party till ten, then home for blankets. Works every time.
B:B: Cozy night in for both of you. Very Moss of you.
Honestly, {partner} and you on the couch, phones down, snacks up. Peaceful.
I'm not crying. I'm just loud about feelings.

questions.scene: Kiki flops dramatically after dancing, then immediately springs back up.
lines: Battery check!! Mine is at 200%!
questions.question: After a big social event: fully charged, or totally drained?

choices.label: Fully charged
reply: Fully charged!! Same!!
People are basically my phone charger.

choices.label: Totally drained
reply: Totally drained. Valid! Moss is the same.
Social battery at 2%. Must lie down. Must not speak.

A:A: Both fully charged!! Extrovert power couple!
I can picture it: you and {partner} go to an afterparty after the afterparty.
Sleep is optional. Fun is mandatory.
A:B: You're drained. {partner} is fully charged.
They'll want to replay the whole night. You'll want a blanket burrito.
Let them talk while you lie down. Listening counts. Nodding counts.
B:A: You're fully charged. {partner} is totally drained.
You want to debrief every conversation. They want the void.
Give them one hour of quiet. THEN tell them all the gossip.
B:B: Both drained. Very understandable.
Pretty sure {partner} and you need a full day of silence after a wedding.
Honestly, a quiet Sunday together sounds perfect.

questions.scene: Kiki practices a handshake on the coat rack.
lines: Guess what!! New people!!
questions.question: At a party full of strangers, what do you do?

choices.label: Say hi to everyone
reply: Say hi to everyone!! A legend!
Name tags? Who needs them. You remember everyone.

choices.label: Stick to people I know
reply: Stick to people you know. Safe and smart.
Your circle, your comfort zone.

choices.label: Befriend the host's pet
reply: Befriend the pet. Moss's strategy exactly.
Pets don't ask 'so what do you do?'

A:A: You both say hi to everyone!! Party tornado couple!
Lowkey, you and {partner} probably know the host's cousin's roommate by the end.
Networking but make it fun.
A:B: You stick to who you know. {partner} talks to everyone.
They'll keep bringing new people over to meet you.
Smile. Nod. Let them do the heavy lifting.
A:C: You find the pet. {partner} greets everyone.
They're networking. You're making a lifelong friend with four paws.
Honestly, you'll have the better story tomorrow.
B:A: You say hi to everyone. {partner} sticks to familiar faces.
You're the social butterfly. They're the home base.
Bring new friends back to them. One at a time. Gently.
B:B: You both stick to people you know. Cozy circle.
{partner} and you probably end up chatting in the same corner all night.
A two-person party within a party. Cute.
B:C: Pet for you. {partner} sticks to familiar faces.
They're with friends. You're with the dog. Everyone's safe.
Bring the dog to their circle. Instant icebreaker.
C:A: You greet the whole room. {partner} finds the pet.
They'll be on the floor with the cat while you work the crowd.
Check in on them. And the cat. Both deserve attention.
C:B: Familiar people for you. {partner} befriends the pet.
You're in a cozy corner. They're under the table with the dog.
Join them. Pets are great listeners.
C:C: You both go straight for the pet. Iconic.
So you and {partner} spend the whole party on the floor with a golden retriever.

questions.scene: Kiki hides behind your door, then jumps out yelling 'SURPRISE!!'
lines: Birthday planning! Moss hates surprises!
questions.question: Birthday: surprise party, or a small dinner you planned yourself?

choices.label: Surprise party
reply: Surprise party!! Confetti in your face! Love it!
Pure chaos. Pure love.

choices.label: Small planned dinner
reply: Small planned dinner. Respect.
You choose the menu, the people, the vibe. Smart.

A:A: Surprise parties for both of you!! Chaos lovers!
Honestly, you and {partner} will spend every birthday trying to out-surprise each other.
Escalation is guaranteed. I'm here for it.
A:B: Small dinner for you. {partner} wants a surprise party.
Careful. They're probably planning one for you RIGHT NOW.
Drop hints. Very clear hints. 'I don't want a party.' Repeatedly.
B:A: Surprise party for you!! {partner} wants a small dinner.
Throw them the dinner. Let them throw you the surprise.
Everyone gets the birthday they actually want. Wow, I'm good.
B:B: Small dinners for both of you. Thoughtful couple.
I can picture it: {partner} and you would rather have three close friends than thirty strangers.
Very mature. Very cozy. Very not me.

questions.scene: Kiki holds his phone up to his ear, then texts instead, then calls again.
lines: I love phone calls! Moss doesn't!
questions.question: Phone calls: love them, or please just text?

choices.label: Love phone calls
reply: Love calls!! Hearing voices is the best!
Why type when you can TALK?

choices.label: Please just text
reply: Please just text. Totally fair.
Phone ringing = mild panic. Same for Moss.

A:A: You both love calls!! Long chats forever!
Pretty sure you and {partner} have three-hour calls about nothing.
That's love. Also your phone bill.
A:B: You prefer text. {partner} loves calls.
They'll call. You'll stare at the phone. Classic.
Pick up once a week. They'll be thrilled. You'll survive.
B:A: You love calls. {partner} prefers texts.
They'll see your name pop up and briefly panic.
Text first: 'can I call?' Tiny warning, big kindness.
B:B: Both team text. Peaceful.
Lowkey, {partner} and you probably send voice notes only in emergencies.
Silence and emojis. Perfect communication.

questions.scene: Kiki stands on a chair, scanning the room like a lighthouse.
lines: Guess what!! I'm the party detective now! I have a tiny notebook!
questions.question: One hour into a party, where do you find your partner?
questions.selfQuestion: One hour into a party, where are you?

choices.label: Center of the dance floor
reply: Dance floor!! Main character energy!
Everyone's watching. Everyone's jealous.

choices.label: In the kitchen by the snacks
reply: Kitchen snacks. Smart.
The kitchen is where the real party is.

choices.label: Quietly petting the host's cat
reply: Petting the cat. Moss's favorite move.
Cats are the best introvert support.

A:A: Dance floor, and {partner} knew it!
They've seen you take over a dance floor before.
Just grab them for the slow song. Mandatory.
A:B: Kitchen snacks for you. {partner} pictured you dancing.
They're looking for you on the dance floor. You're eating dip.
Dance in the kitchen. Everyone wins.
A:C: Petting the cat. {partner} pictured you dancing.
They're looking at the dance floor. You're upstairs with a fluffball.
Moss would do the exact same. You two should hang out.
B:A: You're on the dance floor. {partner} pictured you by the snacks.
Surprise!! You're out there dancing.
Grab a chip on your way to the next song.
B:B: Kitchen snacks, and {partner} knew it!
They know you'll be guarding the guacamole.
Save them a plate. That's love.
B:C: Cat for you. {partner} pictured you by the snacks.
Okay but the cat is technically next to the snacks.
You're both kind of right. Bring the cat a treat.
C:A: Dance floor for you. {partner} pictured you with the cat.
They think you're shy. You're doing the worm.
Plot twist of the night. Iconic.
C:B: Snacks for you. {partner} pictured you with the cat.
Close! You and the cat are both near the food.
Share the cheese. With the cat. Lightly.
C:C: Petting the cat, and {partner} knew it!
They know you'd rather chat with a cat than a crowd.

questions.scene: Kiki makes very intense eye contact, then tilts his head at the door.
lines: That's my 'let's go' face!
questions.question: How does your partner signal they're ready to leave a party?
questions.selfQuestion: How do you signal you're ready to leave a party?

choices.label: Subtle secret eye contact
reply: Secret eye contact. Spy couple!
One look. Mission understood.

choices.label: Announces it to the whole room
reply: Announces it loudly. Honest!
'I'M TIRED, BYE EVERYONE.'

A:A: Secret eye contact, and {partner} knew!
Your one look means 'please get me out of here.' They get it instantly.
Spy-level communication. I'm impressed.
A:B: You announce it loudly. {partner} expected subtle eye contact.
They're waiting for your secret signal. You just yelled 'BYE.'
Efficient. Slightly chaotic. Very effective.
B:A: You use secret eye contact. {partner} expected an announcement.
They might miss your subtle look.
Upgrade to a gentle tug on their sleeve.
B:B: Loud announcement, and {partner} knew!
Everyone at the party now knows you're leaving.
Honesty is a gift. A loud gift.

questions.scene: Kiki pretends to sleep for exactly three seconds, then pops up.
lines: That's how long I can nap! Moss naps for hours!
questions.question: After a busy week, how does your partner recharge?
questions.selfQuestion: After a busy week, how do you recharge?

choices.label: A long solo nap
reply: Long solo nap. Moss approves!
Silence, pillows, zero alarms.

choices.label: Brunch with friends
reply: Brunch with friends!! Social recharge!
Mimosas and gossip. Ideal!

A:A: Long nap, and {partner} knew!
They tiptoe around the house while you sleep. True love.
Snore proudly. They'll pretend it's cute. It is.
A:B: Brunch for you. {partner} expected a nap.
They're tiptoeing around the house. You're out with friends.
Text them a pic of the pancakes. Bring one home.
B:A: You nap. {partner} expected you at brunch.
They imagined you with friends. You're under a blanket.
Hang a 'do not disturb' sign. They'll understand.
B:B: Brunch with friends, and {partner} knew!
They know your social battery fills up with pancakes and gossip.
Bring them back a muffin. Mandatory.

questions.scene: Kiki squeezes into the middle of a group photo frame on your shelf.
lines: Guess what!! Picture time! Moss always hides!
questions.question: Where is your partner in a group photo?
questions.selfQuestion: Where are you in a group photo?

choices.label: Front row, peace sign
reply: Front row!! Peace sign! Iconic!
Main character in every pic.

choices.label: Half hidden behind someone
reply: Half hidden. Mysterious.
Just one eyebrow visible.

A:A: Front row, peace sign, and {partner} knew it!
Every group photo has you, center, mid-pose.
You're the moment. Always.
A:B: You're half hidden. {partner} pictured you front row.
They thought you'd be posing. You're behind someone's hat.
Next time, give them one peace sign. For them.
B:A: You're front and center. {partner} pictured you hiding.
They'll be scanning the back row. You're doing a peace sign up front.
Steal the spot next to them. Photo-bomb with love.
B:B: Half hidden, and {partner} knew it!
They've zoomed in to find you behind someone's shoulder.
Eyebrow-only cameo. Very exclusive. Very you.

questions.scene: Kiki holds up his phone, about to text a big announcement, finger hovering.
lines: GUESS WHAT!! I have news! The news is this question!
questions.question: When your partner has big news, who hears it first?
questions.selfQuestion: When you have big news, who hears it first?

choices.label: Partner first, always
reply: Partner first. Sweet.
Inner circle of two.

choices.label: The group chat, all at once
reply: Group chat! Everyone at once!
Efficient. Loud. Iconic.

A:A: Partner first, and {partner} knew it!
They know they're your first call. Every time.
That's a VIP spot. Treasure it.
A:B: Group chat for you. {partner} expected to hear first.
Oops. They found out with everyone else.
Next time, text them one minute earlier. Huge difference.
B:A: Partner first for you. {partner} expected the group chat.
They didn't realize they're your first call.
Tell them. They'll be secretly thrilled.
B:B: Group chat, and {partner} knew it!
They know your news goes out to everyone at once.
Efficient. Still, save them a personal text.
